card.summary: H.R. 7148, titled the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, became Public Law No. 119-75 on February 3, 2026. This federal law provides funding for the Department of Defense, Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, as well as Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and related agencies for fiscal year 2026. It also sets guidelines for the U.S. Sentencing Commission, extends various healthcare, Medicaid, Medicare, and trade programs, introduces pharmacy benefit management transparency rules, and awards a payment to the widow of a late representative.

card.summary: H.R. 4016 provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for military activities of the Department of Defense, excluding military construction, family housing, Army Corps of Engineers civil works, and nuclear warheads. It sets funding for personnel, operation and maintenance, procurement, research and development, and revolving funds, while establishing strict administrative rules, restrictions, and reporting requirements.

summary: This bill provides fiscal year 2026 appropriations for military activities of the Department of Defense, including personnel, operation and maintenance, procurement, research and development, and related intelligence and health programs, while setting rules and restrictions on the use and transfer of these funds.

affected_groups.effect: Receive pay, allowances, subsistence, training, and retirement fund contributions.
affected_groups.group: Active-duty, reserve, and National Guard military personnel

affected_groups.effect: Subject to rules concerning personnel management, procurement policies, wage limitations, and contract arbitration standards.
affected_groups.group: Department of Defense civilian employees and contractors

affected_groups.effect: Receive training, equipment, logistics support, and security assistance authorized under specific funds and initiatives.
affected_groups.group: Foreign security forces and international partners (such as Ukraine, Taiwan, and forces countering ISIS)

key_provisions: Provides funding for military personnel across the Army, Navy, Marine Corps, Air Force, and Space Force, as well as reserve and National Guard components.
Allocates funds for operation and maintenance activities, including specific funds for the Counter-ISIS Train and Equip Fund and environmental restoration accounts.
Appropriates funds for procurement, including aircraft, missiles, weapons, tracked combat vehicles, ammunition, and shipbuilding and conversion for the Navy.
Funds research, development, test, and evaluation activities across the military departments and defense-wide agencies.
Allocates funding for the Defense Health Program, chemical agents and munitions destruction, drug interdiction and counter-drug activities, and the Office of the Inspector General.
Includes appropriations for related agencies such as the Central Intelligence Agency Retirement and Disability System Fund and the Intelligence Community Management Account.

Sets forth general provisions, restrictions, and transfer authorities governing the use of appropriated funds, including limitations on multiyear contracts, reprogramming rules, and Buy American requirements.
